advisoryTitle: Pre-Tenancy Due Diligence & Physical Inspection Advisory: Old Bodija Flat
whatToVerifyOnSite: Input test codes on the prepaid meter interface (CIU) to confirm true unit credit balance, inspect for illegal bypasses, and crosscheck the physical meter number against IBEDC database records.
Run water into a clean white container from multiple taps to inspect for iron rust, cloudiness, or sulfur odor, and visually verify the filtration media in the double-tank setup.
Inspect the inverter setup, confirming battery type (tubular vs. lithium), date of installation, and execute a manual grid cut-off to test automated load transfer and sustained runtime.
Examine all burglar-proofing welds, window netting integrity against mosquitoes, and check ceilings/walls for hidden damp patches beneath fresh repainting.
Inspect bathroom gully traps, test water pressure with multiple taps running, and ensure the soakaway and compound drainage channels are clear of debris.
hiddenCostChecklist: IBEDC Prepaid Meter Arrears: Visit the Bodija IBEDC business hub to confirm the meter carries no inherited debt or unbilled estimated migration backlog.
Old Bodija CDA & Security Dues: Clarify whether estate gate access, day/night vigilante levies, and recurring transformer maintenance are bundled into the ₦300,000 service charge.
Service Charge Breakdown: Secure an itemized service level agreement (SLA) clarifying shared inverter maintenance, water pumping schedules, and Oyo State Waste Management Authority (OYOWMA) fees.
Legal and Agreement Surcharges: Confirm whether stamp duty, tenancy registration, or inventory documentation fees are tucked into the legal fee draft.
negotiationTips: Cap Agency and Legal fees strictly at 10% each of annual rent (₦260k maximum per professional), resisting the typical 20% markup common among middlemen in Bodija.
Use the Band A power declaration to negotiate the service charge, stipulating that shared diesel generator fueling must be reduced proportionally given the mandatory 20+ hours of daily grid power.
Insist on an agreed, signed move-in condition inventory alongside the ₦200,000 caution fee receipt to legally safeguard your refund when moving out.
